mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MB_NOTIFICATION ( NOTI_NO, CPNY_ID, PERSON_ID, NOTI_TYPE, TITLE, BODY, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, REF_EXTRA, DEDUP_KEY, READ_YN, PUSH_YN, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{notiNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{companyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{recipientId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notiType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{body, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{refExtra, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dedupKey, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N', 'N', SYSDATE, 'MOBILE_NOTI' )
mapper.update: UPDATE MB_NOTIFICATION SET READ_YN = 'Y', READ_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PERSON_ID = #{recipientId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND READ_YN = 'N'
UPDATE MB_NOTIFICATION SET PUSH_YN = 'Y' WHERE NOTI_NO = #{notiNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT EM.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID AS RECIPIENT_ID, HE.CPNY_ID, NVL((SELECT MAX(D.LANG) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY D.UPDATE_DATE) FROM MB_DEVICE D WHERE D.PERSON_ID = EM.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID AND D.ACTIVITY = 1), 'vi') AS DEVICE_LANG, TO_CHAR(EM.APPLY_NO) AS APPLY_NO, TO_CHAR(EM.APPLY_TYPE) AS APPLY_TYPE, TO_CHAR(EM.APPLY_TYPE_CODE) AS CATEGORY, TO_CHAR(EM.AFFIRM_LEVEL) AS AFFIRM_LEVEL, NULL AS AFFIRM_FLAG, HE.LOCAL_NAME AS APPLICANT_NAME, NULL AS TYPE_NAME, CASE TO_CHAR(EM.APPLY_TYPE_CODE) WHEN '21' THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(L.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB L WHERE L.APPLY_NO = EM.APPLY_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) WHEN '31' THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(O.APPLY_OT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') FROM ESS_APPLY_OT O WHERE O.APPLY_NO = EM.APPLY_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) WHEN '218197' THEN (SELECT TO_CHAR(C.FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') FROM ESS_CARD_APPLY_TB C WHERE C.APPLY_NO = EM.APPLY_NO AND ROWNUM = 1) END AS PERIOD FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL EM LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE HE ON HE.PERSON_ID = EM.APPLY_PERSON_ID WHERE EM.ACTIVITY = 0 AND EM.APPLY_AFFIRM_FLAG NOT IN ('14014310', '14014309', '14014308') AND EM.CREATE_DATE >= SYSDATE - #{lookbackDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB TB WHERE TB.APPLY_NO = EM.APPLY_NO AND TB.BATCH_YN = 2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ESS_APPLY_OT OT WHERE OT.APPLY_NO = EM.APPLY_NO AND OT.BATCH_YN = 2) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MB_DEVICE D WHERE D.PERSON_ID = EM.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID AND D.ACTIVITY = 1 AND D.CREATE_DATE <= EM.CREATE_DATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MB_NOTIFICATION N WHERE N.PERSON_ID = EM.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID AND N.DEDUP_KEY = 'APPROVAL_REQUEST:' || EM.APPLY_NO || ':' || EM.AFFIRM_LEVEL) ORDER BY EM.CREATE_DATE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 500

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT R.RECIPIENT_ID, R.CPNY_ID, R.DEVICE_LANG, R.APPLY_NO, NULL AS APPLY_TYPE, R.CATEGORY, NULL AS AFFIRM_LEVEL, R.AFFIRM_FLAG, NULL AS APPLICANT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(R.TYPE_CODE, R.DEVICE_LANG) AS TYPE_NAME, R.PERIOD FROM ( SELECT L.PERSON_ID AS RECIPIENT_ID, L.CPNY_ID, 'LEAVE' AS CATEGORY, TO_CHAR(L.APPLY_NO) AS APPLY_NO, TO_CHAR(L.AFFIRM_FLAG) AS AFFIRM_FLAG, TO_CHAR(L.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE) AS TYPE_CODE, TO_CHAR(L.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS PERIOD, L.CREATE_DATE, NVL((SELECT MAX(D.LANG) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY D.UPDATE_DATE) FROM MB_DEVICE D WHERE D.PERSON_ID = L.PERSON_ID AND D.ACTIVITY = 1), 'vi') AS DEVICE_LANG FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB L WHERE L.ACTIVITY = 1 AND TO_CHAR(L.AFFIRM_FLAG) IN ('14014308', '14014309') AND L.CREATE_DATE >= SYSDATE - #{lookbackDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC} UNION ALL SELECT O.PERSON_ID, O.CPNY_ID, 'OT', TO_CHAR(O.APPLY_NO), TO_CHAR(O.AFFIRM_FLAG), TO_CHAR(O.OT_TYPE_CODE), TO_CHAR(O.APPLY_OT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), O.CREATE_DATE, NVL((SELECT MAX(D.LANG) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY D.UPDATE_DATE) FROM MB_DEVICE D WHERE D.PERSON_ID = O.PERSON_ID AND D.ACTIVITY = 1), 'vi') FROM ESS_APPLY_OT O WHERE O.ACTIVITY = 1 AND TO_CHAR(O.AFFIRM_FLAG) IN ('14014308', '14014309') AND O.CREATE_DATE >= SYSDATE - #{lookbackDays, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) R WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MB_DEVICE D WHERE D.PERSON_ID = R.RECIPIENT_ID AND D.ACTIVITY = 1 AND D.CREATE_DATE <= R.CREATE_DATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MB_NOTIFICATION N WHERE N.PERSON_ID = R.RECIPIENT_ID AND N.DEDUP_KEY = 'APPLY_RESULT:' || R.CATEGORY || ':' || R.APPLY_NO) ORDER BY R.CREATE_DATE ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 500
SELECT DEVICE_ID, FCM_TOKEN FROM MB_DEVICE WHERE PERSON_ID = #{recipientId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ACTIVITY = 1 AND FCM_TOKEN IS NOT NULL
